body:
"yesfish" from the Discord was kind enough to take a look at the MRP and replied with a solution. It turned out to be a configuration issue.

> Got around to playing with it a bit.
> The root and scale base aren't set for the profile, so it doesn't have the information needed to adjust the scale.
> There should only be one nonhumanoid_skeleton_profile.tres, that is assigned to every model that uses that type of skeleton.
> 
> Say I had a range of animated fish models. I'd either pick one, or create an ideal fish that's as midway between all the other fish as possible. From the selected specimen I'd then create fish_skeleton_profile.tres, setting root, and..well I'd have to experiment with what would work as scale-base. Then every .glb file that had a fish-like skeleton would be assigned fish_skeleton_profile.tres.
> 
> There's also an additional setting at the bottom called "[fix_silhouette](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/tutorials/assets_pipeline/retargeting_3d_skeletons.html#fix-silhouette)" that might help.

Closing this issue.
